description: This file defines the MemoryPanel class, which provides methods to interact with the Memory panel in a calculator UI test framework. It includes methods to open the memory panel, retrieve memory items, clear memory, resize the window to display UI elements, and interact with the memory flyout.

classes.name: MemoryPanel
classes.description: A class providing automation methods to interact with the calculator's memory panel and flyout in UI tests.

methods.name: OpenMemoryPanel
methods.description: Opens the Memory Panel by clicking the Memory label.

methods.name: GetAllMemoryListViewItems
methods.description: Retrieves all memory items listed in the Memory Panel.

methods.name: ClearMemoryPanel
methods.description: Opens the Memory Panel and deletes all memory items if the delete button is visible.

methods.name: ResizeWindowToDisplayMemoryLabel
methods.description: Resizes the window until the Memory Label is visible.

methods.name: ResizeWindowToDisplayMemoryButton
methods.description: Resizes the window until the Memory Button is visible.

methods.name: OpenMemoryFlyout
methods.description: Opens the Memory Flyout by resizing window and sending hotkeys.

methods.name: GetAllMemoryFlyoutListViewItems
methods.description: Retrieves all memory items listed in the Memory Flyout.

methods.name: GrowWindowToShowMemoryLabel
methods.description: Recursively increases window size until the Memory Label is visible or maximum width is reached.

methods.name: ShrinkWindowToShowMemoryButton
methods.description: Recursively decreases window size until the Memory Button is visible or minimum width is reached.
